meta.name: Generative Fill (Qwen-Image-2.1)
meta.licenseNote: Qwen-Image-2.1 (Alibaba Qwen, 2026-09-20) ships under the Qwen Research License Agreement: research and evaluation use only; commercial use needs a separate agreement with Alibaba. Turn on Allow Research-Only Models in Preferences › AI Integrations to use it.
meta.notes: Node names and settings follow ComfyUI's official 'Image Edit (Qwen Image 2.1)' template (image_qwen_image_2_1_image_edit.json): UNETLoader → QwenImage21Cache, CLIPLoader type qwen_image, TextEncodeQwenImage21 (clip, vae, prompt, negative_prompt, resolution 0 = keep the input's size, image_1; outputs positive, negative and the encoded latent of image_1), KSampler euler/simple 25 steps CFG 1 denoise 1, VAEDecode. Inpainting is added with core nodes: the mask PNG is loaded, turned into a MASK and applied to the encoder's latent with SetLatentNoiseMask, so only the selected area is regenerated. The template's optional prompt-enhancement encoder (qwen3.5_9b_qwen_image_2.1_pe_i2i) is left out; at CFG 1 the negative prompt has no effect but is wired for completeness.
